description: Integration test gated on NNTP_INTEROP_LEAFNODE=host:port env var (skipped with #[ignore] when unset). Same two-direction structure as the INN test: stoa→leafnode and leafnode→stoa. Leafnode speaks a subset of RFC 4644; verify stoa degrades gracefully if MODE STREAM is not offered and falls back to IHAVE. Covers gap 3 from the interop audit.
title: test: stoa IHAVE/TAKETHIS interop with leafnode
